title: Complications of chronic kidney disease
summary: Chronic kidney disease (not requiring dialysis) with three hospitalizations in 12 months for complications such as anemia, osteodystrophy, neuropathy, fluid overload, or atherosclerotic renovascular disease, with each hospitalization ≥48 hours and 30 days apart.

children.criterion: Chronic kidney disease (not requiring chronic dialysis)
Three hospitalizations within 12 months for CKD complications, each lasting ≥48 hours, with at least 30 days between hospitalizations
